title: 4.1 Rooms at Home
unit_outcome: Talk about your home, where things are, your morning, what you do at home, the days, the time and the months in Spanish.
goal: Name the rooms of a home and say where people are with estar: La abuela está en la cocina.
grammar_function: Este/Esta es + room; persona + está/están + en + room.
